description.value: Locavore Food Truck is a takeout food truck based in Squamish, BC, with a focus on local cuisine. Food trucks like this are a welcome stop for touring cyclists looking for a quick, freshly made meal along the Sea-to-Sky corridor. No address is listed in OSM, suggesting the truck operates from a rotating or seasonal location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL from OSM resolves to a GoDaddy parked domain page, indicating the business's own website is defunct — no business content could be retrieved. All amenity fields therefore rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms takeaway=yes and cuisine=local; all other amenity fields remain null. The parked domain raises genuine uncertainty about whether the food truck is still actively operating.
concerns: Website http://www.locavorefoodtruck.ca/ is a parked GoDaddy domain — no active business content found. This may indicate the business has closed or relocated.
No physical address recorded in OSM, making it difficult to verify the truck's current operating location.
No phone or email contact available to verify operational status.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The listed website is a parked GoDaddy domain with no business content, raising genuine uncertainty about whether the food truck is still actively operating. A manual check of the physical location or social media presence is needed before inclusion.
